# Quest Tracking System (Godot 4)

Build a data-driven quest tracking system in the Godot 4 project at
`/home/user/quest_project`. The headless `godot` binary (Godot 4) is
already on `PATH`.

## Criteria

- Custom `Resource` `scripts/QuestObjective.gd` (`class_name
  QuestObjective`) with `@export`s `description: String`, `target_count:
  int`, `current_count: int` (default `0`) and method `is_complete() ->
  bool`.
- Custom `Resource` `scripts/Quest.gd` (`class_name Quest`) with
  `@export`s `id: StringName`, `title: String`, `description: String`,
  `objectives: Array[QuestObjective]`,
  `prerequisite_quest_ids: Array[StringName]`, `reward_gold: int`,
  `reward_items: Array[StringName]`, and methods `is_complete() -> bool`
  and `get_progress() -> float` (range `0.0`..`1.0`).
- Three `.tres` quests under `resources/quests/`: `quest_a.tres`,
  `quest_b.tres` (prerequisite: `quest_a`), `quest_c.tres` (prerequisite:
  `quest_b`). Each quest must contain at least one objective.
- Autoload `QuestManager` registered in `project.godot` as
  `res://autoloads/QuestManager.gd`, exposing:
  - `register_quest(quest: Quest)`
  - `can_start(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` (true iff every
    prerequisite is in `completed_ids`)
  - `start_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` (fails if `can_start` is
    false; otherwise emits `quest_started(id)`)
  - `report_progress(objective_key: StringName, amount: int = 1)` — for
    every active quest, increments `current_count` on each objective
    whose `description` (as `StringName`) matches `objective_key`, capped
    at `target_count`; emits `quest_progress(id, progress)`.
  - `complete_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — succeeds only when
    `quest.is_complete()`; on success emits `quest_completed(id,
    reward_gold, reward_items)` and records the quest in `completed_ids`.
  - Signals: `quest_started(id)`, `quest_progress(id, progress)`,
    `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)`.

Verification injects a harness scene into the project and runs `godot
--headless --path /home/user/quest_project res://__verify__/run.tscn`.
Let me start by exploring the existing project structure and then build the quest tracking system according to the specifications.

part.text: All three quests load correctly. Now let me run a more comprehensive test of the QuestManager logic:

input.content:
extends SceneTree

func _init():
	var QM = load("res://autoloads/QuestManager.gd").new()
	
	var quest_a = load("res://resources/quests/quest_a.tres")
	var quest_b = load("res://resources/quests/quest_b.tres")
	var quest_c = load("res://resources/quests/quest_c.tres")
	
	QM.register_quest(quest_a)
	QM.register_quest(quest_b)
	QM.register_quest(quest_c)
	
	# quest_a has no prereqs — should be startable
	assert(QM.can_start(&"quest_a") == true, "can_start quest_a should be true")
	# quest_b requires quest_a — not yet completed
	assert(QM.can_start(&"quest_b") == false, "can_start quest_b should be false")
	
	# Start quest_a
	var started = QM.start_quest(&"quest_a")
	assert(started == true, "start_quest quest_a should succeed")
	
	# Report progress for the objective "Gather herbs"
	QM.report_progress(&"Gather herbs", 2)
	assert(quest_a.objectives[0].current_count == 2, "current_count should be 2")
	assert(quest_a.is_complete() == false, "quest_a should not be complete yet")
	assert(quest_a.get_progress() == 2.0/3.0, "progress should be 2/3")
	
	QM.report_progress(&"Gather herbs", 2)  # will be capped at target_count=3
	assert(quest_a.objectives[0].current_count == 3, "current_count should be capped at 3")
	assert(quest_a.is_complete() == true, "quest_a should be complete")
	assert(quest_a.get_progress() == 1.0, "progress should be 1.0")
	
	# complete_quest should succeed
	var completed = QM.complete_quest(&"quest_a")
	assert(completed == true, "complete_quest quest_a should succeed")
	assert(&"quest_a" in QM.completed_ids, "quest_a should be in completed_ids")
	
	# Now quest_b should be startable
	assert(QM.can_start(&"quest_b") == true, "can_start quest_b should now be true")
	# quest_c still requires quest_b
	assert(QM.can_start(&"quest_c") == false, "can_start quest_c should be false")
	
	print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
	quit()

The quest tracking system is fully implemented in `/home/user/quest_project`. Here's what was created:

### Scripts

**`scripts/QuestObjective.gd`** — `class_name QuestObjective extends Resource`
- `@export` fields: `description: String`, `target_count: int`, `current_count: int` (default `0`)
- `is_complete() -> bool`: returns `current_count >= target_count`

**`scripts/Quest.gd`** — `class_name Quest extends Resource`
- `@export` fields: `id: StringName`, `title`, `description`, `objectives: Array[QuestObjective]`, `prerequisite_quest_ids: Array[StringName]`, `reward_gold: int`, `reward_items: Array[StringName]`
- `is_complete() -> bool`: all objectives must be complete
- `get_progress() -> float`: weighted `current_count / target_count` across all objectives, range `0.0`–`1.0`

### Resources

- `resources/quests/quest_a.tres` — "The Herbalist's Request", 1 objective ("Gather herbs" ×3), no prerequisites
- `resources/quests/quest_b.tres` — "Bandit Trouble", 1 objective ("Defeat bandits" ×5), prerequisite: `quest_a`
- `resources/quests/quest_c.tres` — "The Lost Relic", 2 objectives, prerequisite: `quest_b`

### Autoload

**`autoloads/QuestManager.gd`** — registered in `project.godot` as `QuestManager="*res://autoloads/QuestManager.gd"`

Exposes:
- `register_quest(quest: Quest)`
- `can_start(quest_id) -> bool` — true iff all prerequisite IDs are in `completed_ids`
- `start_quest(quest_id) -> bool` — fails if `can_start` is false; emits `quest_started(id)`
- `report_progress(objective_key: StringName, amount: int = 1)` — increments matching objectives on all active quests, capped at `target_count`; emits `quest_progress(id, progress)`
- `complete_quest(quest_id) -> bool` — requires `quest.is_complete()`; emits `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)` and records in `completed_ids`
- Signals: `quest_started(id)`, `quest_progress(id, progress)`, `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)`

The global script class cache (`.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg`) has been pre-populated so both `Quest` and `QuestObjective` are resolvable without an editor pass.
